summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of a government subsidy payment of R$170 million for diesel oil commercialization under Provisional Measure No. 1,340, covering the period April 1-6, 2026. This is a routine operational update from the Brazilian state-controlled oil and gas company, equivalent to a current report on Form 6-K for foreign private issuers. No terms, consideration, premium, dates beyond the payment, or board recommendations are stated. There is no special-situation event; the filing merely discloses a government program installment.
